support.heading: Need help? We're here for you.
support.intro: Find answers to the most common questions about Librea below. Can't find what you're looking for? Just send us a message — we're happy to help.

faq.q: How do I list a book?
faq.a: Tap the plus button and scan the barcode on the back of the book — the title, author and cover are recognised automatically. Then add the condition and your price, and publish your listing.

faq.q: How do buying, selling and swapping work?
faq.a: Find a book near you and message the owner directly in the chat. Agree on a purchase, swap or giveaway and pick a meeting point nearby — no shipping needed. Handover and payment happen in person, on the spot.

faq.q: How do I reset my password?
faq.a: On the sign-in screen, tap “Forgot password?” and enter your email address. We'll send you a link to set a new password.

faq.q: How do I edit my profile?
faq.a: Open the Profile tab and tap “Edit profile”. There you can change your name, profile picture and details at any time.

faq.q: How do I report a user or a listing?
faq.a: Open the profile or listing in question, tap the menu (⋯) and choose “Report”. Briefly describe the problem — our team reviews every report. For urgent cases, reach us at milantornier0@gmail.com.

faq.q: How do I delete my account?
faq.a: Go to Profile → Settings → Danger Zone and tap “Delete account”. Your account and all personal data — profile, listings, messages, reviews and uploaded images — are deleted immediately and permanently. Residual copies in encrypted backups are removed within 30 days.

support.contactBody: Send us an email — we're happy to help.
